answer_1.quote: We evaluate sequence tagging tasks such as Named Entity Recognition, Slot-Labeling for Semantic Parsing, and Semantic Role Labeling.

answer_2.quote: We primarily relied on two metrics: 1. Perfect: This reflects the % of times, an example is parsed perfectly i.e., all tagged spans are identified correctly with the right tag. 2. F1: Using CoNLL style evaluation of tagged spans, we report Micro F1 (Macro-F1 trends were consistent with Micro-F1 findings).
